gain.label: Level
gain.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0.05 to 20.

pres_lin.label: Dynamics (even)
pres_lin.hover: The even part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and a light touch already speaks. Range 0 to 1.

pres_sq.label: Dynamics (curved)
pres_sq.hover: The curved part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and the loud end opens up faster than the soft end. Range 0 to 1.5.

pres_hz.label: Response
pres_hz.hover: How quickly the sound follows a change of pressure: low is a slow swell, high is immediate. Range 2 to 200 Hz.

release.label: Release
release.hover: How long the sound takes to die away after the key is released. Range 0.005 to 1 s.

rel_pedal.label: Release with pedal
rel_pedal.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 3 s.

p_soft.label: Breath, soft
p_soft.hover: The blowing pressure at the lightest touch, relative to where the tone just speaks: above 1 it always speaks, below 1 a light touch is only air. Range 0.5 to 3.

p_loud.label: Breath, loud
p_loud.hover: The blowing pressure at a full press: higher is louder and brighter, and pushes the tone harder. Range 1.1 to 20.

p_reg.label: Breath by register
p_reg.hover: How the blowing pressure changes going up the range: above 0 the high notes get more air. Range -0.5 to 1.5.

p_curve.label: Breath curve
p_curve.hover: The shape of the curve from key pressure to blowing pressure: below 1 soft playing is easier, above 1 the loud end comes later. Range 0.3 to 3.

lip_tune.label: Lip tuning
lip_tune.hover: Where the lips' resonance sits relative to the note: below 0 the lips strike outward. Range -600 to 300 cents.

lip_treg.label: Lip tuning by register
lip_treg.hover: How the lip tuning changes per octave up. Range -300 to 300 cents.

lip_q.label: Lip sharpness
lip_q.hover: How sharp the lips' resonance is. Range 0.5 to 60.

lip_mass.label: Lip mass
lip_mass.hover: How heavy the lips are, on B flat 4. Range 0.2 to 30 kg/m².

mass_reg.label: Lip mass by register
mass_reg.hover: How much lighter the lips get per octave up. Range -0.5 to 2 octaves.

lip_open.label: Lip opening
lip_open.hover: How open the lips rest, on B flat 4. Range 0 to 1.5 mm.

open_reg.label: Opening by register
open_reg.hover: How much smaller the opening gets per octave up. Range -1 to 2 octaves.

lip_width.label: Lip width
lip_width.hover: How wide the lip opening is. Range 3 to 15 mm.

contact.label: Lip contact
contact.hover: How stiff the lips are when they close against each other. Range 0 to 20.

lip_nl.label: Lip losses
lip_nl.hover: How much the lips lose energy as they move faster: tames the loud end. Range 0 to 100.

embouch.label: Embouchure firms
embouch.hover: How much the embouchure firms with the breath: 1 the aperture holds. Range 0 to 1.5.

lip_tilt.label: Lips by timbre
lip_tilt.hover: How much timbre firms the lips: up brightens. Range -1.5 to 1.5.

jitter.label: Jitter
jitter.hover: A fine, fast roughness of the pitch, like a living lip. Range 0 to 40 cents.

cup.label: Cup volume
cup.hover: The size of the mouthpiece cup. Range 0.2 to 2.5 cm³.

pop_hz.label: Mouthpiece pop
pop_hz.hover: Where the mouthpiece's own resonance sits. Range 300 to 3000 Hz.

pop_q.label: Mouthpiece pop sharpness
pop_q.hover: How sharp the mouthpiece's resonance is. Range 0.5 to 10.

bore_decay.label: Bore decay
bore_decay.hover: How long the tube's resonance rings: the bloom and the tail. Range 0.005 to 0.2 s.

bore_reg.label: Bore by register
bore_reg.hover: How much shorter the tube's ring gets per octave up. Range -1 to 2 octaves.

bell_hz.label: Bell cutoff
bell_hz.hover: The frequency above which the bell stops reflecting: the resonances above it fade. Range 150 to 4000 Hz.

brassiness.label: Brassiness
brassiness.hover: How much the tone blares and steepens as it gets loud. Range 0 to 1500.

rad_hz.label: Radiation low cut
rad_hz.hover: The frequency below which the instrument radiates less. Range 20 to 2000 Hz.

tone_hz.label: Tone
tone_hz.hover: The brightness of the radiated tone: the frequency above which it rolls off. Range 500 to 16000 Hz.

tone_q.label: Tone sharpness
tone_q.hover: How sharp the tone roll-off is. Range 0.5 to 2.

low_comp.label: Low compensation
low_comp.hover: How much the low notes are brought up in level. Range 0 to 2.

breath.label: Breath noise
breath.hover: The audible breath in the tone. Range 0 to 0.8.

t_noise.label: Tongue "t"
t_noise.hover: The short noise burst of a tongued start. Range 0 to 1.

tongue.label: Strike
tongue.hover: How much a hard strike sharpens the start: the tongue's hold and release, the accent and the "t". Range 0 to 2.

acc_level.label: Accent
acc_level.hover: The extra push at the start of a struck note: 0 none, higher is a sharper attack. Range 0 to 1.5.

acc_decay.label: Accent length
acc_decay.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.01 to 0.3 s.

tongue_t.label: Tongue release
tongue_t.hover: How long the tongue takes to let the note go on a soft start; a hard strike is many times faster. Range 0.001 to 0.05 s.

tongue_lip.label: Tongue on the lips
tongue_lip.hover: How far the tongue holds the lips closed on a tongued start. Range 0 to 2 mm.

slur.label: Slur
slur.hover: How much articulation a legato note change gets: 0 seamless, 1 each new note is re-tongued. Range 0 to 1.

pitch_t.label: Pitch settling
pitch_t.hover: How fast the player's ear pulls the pitch to its centre after a start or a change. Range 0.003 to 0.3 s.

flutter.label: Flutter by shake
flutter.hover: How much flutter tongue a shake (the motion input) adds. Range 0 to 1.

flut_hz.label: Flutter rate
flut_hz.hover: How fast the flutter tongue rolls. Range 8 to 40 Hz.
